__comment: The finished goods pallet (doc 62, concept A, log skids; owner's pick 2026-11-02): split poles laid across two log runners, split face up, lashed at the ends, within its 2 x 2 footprint. Tier 1 Hearthblock model from tools/hearthblock/art/tier1.mjs.
Carpenters make it at the carpenter's bench from two matching logs; it keeps their wood. It stands on the floor, and dwarves reach onto it from any side.

storage (ContainerStorageComponent): it holds packed furniture (stockpile_furniture), the finished goods the colony makes today (owner, 2026-11-02), one piece to each of its four quarters, starting at priority 4, ahead of ground storage. Copper bars (doc 297) are stored with metal, not here; planks and dressed stone may join it when they exist. The anchors are its quarters' centres on the deck (X and Z 8 cells from its centre, the deck top 7 cells up), in footprint-local blocks from the back-left floor corner; each filled quarter shows its piece standing on the deck.
description: Split poles laid across two log runners. It keeps four pieces of packed furniture, one to each quarter, until they are placed.
